title: Activité des membres
description: Qui s'est connecté, quand, et tout ce que la base garde de ses actions. Filtrer un ou plusieurs membres en haut.

list.name: membre
list.label: Membre
list.query: SELECT username AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM core.users ORDER BY lower(username)
list.definition: SELECT username AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM core.users ORDER BY lower(username)

panels.title: Qui s'est connecté sur la période
panels.description: Jours connectés : jours (heure de Paris) où le membre a ouvert ou prolongé une session sur la période choisie. Vide : aucune connexion sur la période ; la dernière connexion connue dit depuis quand.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.username AS "Membre",
               count(DISTINCT (rt.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date) AS "Jours connectés",
               min(rt.created_at) AS "Première connexion", max(rt.created_at) AS "Dernière connexion",
               (SELECT max(created_at) FROM core.refresh_tokens x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AS "Dernière connexion connue",
               CASE WHEN u.active THEN 'Actif' ELSE 'Désactivé' END AS "Compte", u.created_at AS "Compte créé le"
        FROM core.users u LEFT JOIN core.refresh_tokens rt ON rt.user_id = u.id AND $__timeFilter(rt.created_at)
        WHERE u.id::text IN ($membre)
        GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY 2 DESC, lower(u.username)

panels.title: Connexions par jour et par membre
panels.description: Une couleur par membre : la hauteur d'une barre est le nombre de membres connectés ce jour-là.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', rt.created_at) AS time, m.username AS metric, 1 AS value
        FROM core.refresh_tokens rt JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = rt.user_id
        WHERE $__timeFilter(rt.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bilan de la sélection sur la période

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT (rt.user_id, (rt.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date)) FROM core.refresh_tokens rt
        WHERE rt.user_id::text IN ($membre) AND $__timeFilter(rt.created_at)

panels.title: Présences annoncées
panels.description: Réponses « présent » à des événements de la période (intention, pas présence vérifiée).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FROM events.event_participation p JOIN events.events e ON e.id = p.event_id
        WHERE p.user_id::text IN ($membre) AND p.status = 1 AND $__timeFilter(e.start_date_time)
SELECT count(*) FROM events.operation_assignments a WHERE a.user_id::text IN ($membre) AND $__timeFilter(a.created_at)

SELECT count(*) FROM session.participants pa JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = pa.sheet_id
        WHERE pa.user_id::text IN ($membre) AND $__timeFilter(sh.session_date)

panels.title: Frais avancés (aUEC)
panels.description: Frais de minage payés pour le groupe, raffinage compris.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(ex.amount) FROM (SELECT sheet_id, payer_user_id, kind, amount FROM session.expenses
       UNION ALL SELECT sheet_id, launcher_user_id, 'REFINING', cost FROM mining.refinery_orders WHERE cost > 0) ex JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = ex.sheet_id
        WHERE ex.payer_user_id::text IN ($membre) AND $__timeFilter(sh.session_date)
SELECT sum(sa.amount) FROM session.sales sa WHERE sa.seller_user_id::text IN ($membre) AND $__timeFilter(sa.sold_at)

panels.title: Journal d'activité
panels.description: Tout ce que la base date et rattache à un membre. Ce qui n'est pas enregistré (pages consultées, messages Discord, lectures) n'y figure pas. Les connexions sont regroupées par jour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
          SELECT min(rt.created_at) AS "Date", m.username AS "Membre", 'Connexion' AS "Action",
                 'de ' || to_char(min(rt.created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris', 'HH24"h"MI') || ' à '
                 || to_char(max(rt.created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris', 'HH24"h"MI') || ' (heure de Paris)' AS "Détail"
            FROM core.refresh_tokens rt JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = rt.user_id
           WHERE $__timeFilter(rt.created_at) GROUP BY m.username, (rt.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
          UNION ALL SELECT u.created_at, m.username, 'Compte créé', NULL FROM core.users u JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = u.id
          UNION ALL SELECT e.created_at, m.username, 'Événement créé', e.title
            FROM events.events e JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = e.creator_id
          UNION ALL SELECT e.start_date_time, m.username, 'Réponse à un événement',
                 e.title || ' : ' || CASE p.status WHEN 1 THEN 'présent' WHEN 0 THEN 'peut-être' ELSE 'absent' END
                 || ' (date de l''événement : la réponse n''est pas datée)'
            FROM events.event_participation p JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = p.user_id JOIN events.events e ON e.id = p.event_id
          UNION ALL SELECT a.created_at, m.username, 'Affectation à une opération',
                 e.title || coalesce(' · ' || g.name, '') || CASE WHEN a.status = 'PENDING' THEN ' (en attente)' ELSE '' END
            FROM events.operation_assignments a JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = a.user_id
            JOIN events.events e ON e.id = a.operation_event_id LEFT JOIN events.operation_groups g ON g.id = a.group_id
          UNION ALL SELECT r.created_at, m.username, 'Demande de place dans une opération',
                 e.title || ' (' || CASE r.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'en attente' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'acceptée'
                                                  WHEN 'REFUSED' THEN 'refusée' ELSE 'annulée' END || ')'
            FROM events.operation_assignment_requests r JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = r.user_id
            JOIN events.events e ON e.id = r.operation_event_id
          UNION ALL SELECT sp.created_at, m.username, 'Vaisseau proposé à une opération',
                 e.title || coalesce(' · ' || s.name, '') || ' (' || CASE sp.status WHEN 'PROPOSED' THEN 'proposé'
                     WHEN 'ACCEPTED' THEN 'accepté' WHEN 'DECLINED' THEN 'refusé' ELSE 'indisponible' END || ')'
            FROM events.operation_ship_proposals sp JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = sp.owner_user_id
            JOIN events.events e ON e.id = sp.operation_event_id LEFT JOIN catalog.ship_compat s ON s.id = sp.ship_id
          UNION ALL SELECT gp.created_at, m.username, 'Contribution à un objectif',
                 g.name || ' : ' || CASE WHEN gp.delta >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || gp.delta
            FROM goals.goal_participations gp JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = gp.user_id JOIN goals.goals g ON g.id = gp.goal_id
          UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(w.updated_at, w.created_at), m.username, 'Événement Star Citizen',
                 ev.title || ' : ' || w.total || ' points'
            FROM scworld.sc_world_event_participation w JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = w.user_id
            JOIN scworld.sc_world_event ev ON ev.id = w.scwe_id
          UNION ALL SELECT us.created_at, m.username, 'Vaisseau ajouté à la flotte', coalesce(s.name, 'Vaisseau n°' || us.ship_id)
            FROM fleet.user_ships us JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = us.user_id LEFT JOIN catalog.ship_compat s ON s.id = us.ship_id
          UNION ALL SELECT c.updated_at, m.username, 'Collection mise à jour', NULL
            FROM collections.user_collection c JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id::text = c.user_id
          UNION ALL SELECT n.created_at, m.username, 'Notifications push activées', NULL
            FROM core.notification_subscriptions n JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = n.user_id
          UNION ALL SELECT i.uploaded_at, m.username, 'Image envoyée', i.category
            FROM media.image_metadata i JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = i.uploader_id
          UNION ALL SELECT sh.created_at, m.username, 'Fiche de minage créée', sh.name
            FROM session.sheets sh JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = sh.organizer_user_id
          UNION ALL SELECT pa.joined_at, m.username, 'Ajouté à une fiche de minage', sh.name
            FROM session.participants pa JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = pa.user_id JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = pa.sheet_id
          UNION ALL SELECT ex.created_at, m.username, 'Frais avancé (minage)',
                 sh.name || ' : ' || CASE ex.kind WHEN 'FUEL' THEN 'carburant' WHEN 'REPAIR' THEN 'réparation'
                     WHEN 'MATERIAL' THEN 'matériel' ELSE 'autre' END || ' ' || replace(to_char(ex.amount, 'FM999,999,999,999'), ',', ' ') || ' aUEC'
            FROM session.expenses ex JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = ex.payer_user_id JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = ex.sheet_id
          UNION ALL SELECT ro.created_at, m.username, 'Ordre de raffinage lancé',
                 sh.name || ' : ' || ro.terminal_label || CASE WHEN ro.cost > 0 THEN ', ' || replace(to_char(ro.cost, 'FM999,999,999,999'), ',', ' ') || ' aUEC' ELSE '' END
            FROM mining.refinery_orders ro JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = ro.launcher_user_id JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = ro.sheet_id
          UNION ALL SELECT sa.sold_at, m.username, 'Vente de minerai',
                 sh.name || ' : ' || replace(to_char(sa.amount, 'FM999,999,999,999'), ',', ' ') || ' aUEC à ' || sa.terminal_label
            FROM session.sales sa JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = sa.seller_user_id JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = sa.sheet_id
          UNION ALL SELECT t.received_at, m.username, 'Virement reçu (minage)',
                 sh.name || ' : ' || replace(to_char(t.amount, 'FM999,999,999,999'), ',', ' ') || ' aUEC de ' || f.username
            FROM session.settlement_transfers t JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = t.to_user_id JOIN core.users f ON f.id = t.from_user_id
            JOIN session.settlements s ON s.id = t.settlement_id JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = s.sheet_id
           WHERE t.received_at IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL SELECT h.at, m.username, 'Fiche de minage : ' || CASE h.action WHEN 'SETTLED' THEN 'comptes arrêtés'
                     WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 'clôture' WHEN 'FORCED_CLOSE' THEN 'clôture forcée' WHEN 'REOPENED_SETTLEMENT' THEN 'réouverture du règlement'
                     WHEN 'REOPENED_ACTIVE' THEN 'retour en cours' WHEN 'RECEIPT_CONFIRMED' THEN 'virement confirmé'
                     ELSE 'confirmation retirée' END, sh.name
            FROM session.history h JOIN (SELECT id, username FROM core.users WHERE id::text IN ($membre)) m ON m.id = h.actor_user_id JOIN session.sheets sh ON sh.id = h.sheet_id
        ) journal
        WHERE "Date" BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
        ORDER BY "Date" DESC LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Membres sans connexion sur la période
panels.description: Comptes actifs du filtre sans aucune connexion sur la période. Vide en « Dernière connexion connue » : jamais connecté depuis la mise en place des jetons de session.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.username AS "Membre", (SELECT max(created_at) FROM core.refresh_tokens x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AS "Dernière connexion connue",
               u.created_at AS "Compte créé le"
        FROM core.users u
        WHERE u.active AND u.id::text IN ($membre)
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.refresh_tokens rt WHERE rt.user_id = u.id AND $__timeFilter(rt.created_at))
        ORDER BY 2 NULLS FIRST, lower(u.username)
